In square \(ABCD\), \(\angle DAB=90^\circ\).

In equilateral triangle \(AED\), each angle is \(60^\circ\), so
\[
\angle DAE=60^\circ.
\]

Since \(E\) lies inside \(\angle DAB\),
\[
\angle BAE=\angle DAB-\angle DAE=90^\circ-60^\circ=30^\circ.
\]

The answer is \(30^\circ\).
